# Lottie canvas renderer

`lottie_light_canvas.min.js` is the canvas-only light build from `lottie-web` 5.13.0.
It has no expression evaluator. It is loaded from Register only when an animated
Telegram sticker becomes visible, without contacting a third-party CDN.

Source: https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web/tree/v5.13.0
Distribution: `https://registry.npmjs.org/lottie-web/-/lottie-web-5.13.0.tgz`,
`package/build/player/lottie_light_canvas.min.js`.

Upstream's MIT license is in `LICENSE.md`.
